result.title: SwiftLoop: Selective Refinement for Adaptive Implicit Reasoning in Looped Transformers
result.summary: Looped Transformers advance implicit chain-of-thought reasoning through recurrent latent refinement. However, existing looped reasoners typically employ fixed-depth recurrence, updating all latent positions at every iteration and incurring redundancy when further refinement is unnecessary. We introduce \textsc{SwiftLoop}, an inference-time framework for selective recurrent refinement through position-wise freezing, enabling adaptive computation allocation across both recurrent depth and active width. SwiftLoop learns lightweight freezing policies through hindsight-guided supervision derived from two complementary criteria: K/V reusability at the internal representation level and functional impact at the output level. At inference time, these policies guide adaptive freezing based on observed hidden states. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SwiftLoop achieves favorable accuracy--computation trade-offs over fixed-loop inference and adaptive baselines, with measured inference acceleration. Beyond implicit reasoning, we further demonstrate its applicability to recurrent prompt prefilling in general looped models.

AI.brief_summary: SwiftLoop 提出一种推理期的 looped Transformer 选择性循环精炼框架，按位置冻结 latent 更新，并用 K/V 可复用性与输出功能影响两类事后监督学习轻量冻结策略，以在循环深度和活跃宽度上自适应分配计算。
AI.relevance_reason: 逐位置冻结与「K/V 可复用性／功能影响」双准则可供核查 LVR 的 STOP 决策和 latent 状态价值估计；但该文在文本隐式推理与通用 looped 模型上验证，向视觉证据筛选的迁移仍待检验。
